calibration_scope: conditional performance at three fixed noise settings only
numerical_rule: 17 to 33 parameter hypotheses at K2 and K8 to K32 states at grid33, at all three fixed settings in the recent128 window, each have maximum absolute paired-episode mean log-loss shift <=0.005 nats; other comparisons are diagnostics
inference: paired physical-seed t95 and shared whole-episode percentile bootstrap; unadjusted development planning, not a confirmatory claim
selection_rule: earliest prefix satisfying every recent128 forecast target, bank terminal parameter target, measured bank cost target, reference sensitivity, complete main/reference exposure, and short-exact software validation; cumulative scores and point-estimator targets are sensitivity diagnostics
bootstrap_unit: physical seed, shared across methods, settings and prefixes
